_comment: Per-game local tweaks the CLI has to know before anything is built: where a
game lands on disk, and which file inside it to launch. How a game runs —
emulator, arguments, settings — lives in src/client/env instead.
Key by id, or by platform/id when the same id exists on several platforms.
target:   glob for the file to launch, relative to the installed game
unzip:    the game installs as a directory of the unpacked ROM. The
unpacking itself is the game environment's recipe; this flag
is the half the CLI needs offline — the shape of the path.
_comment_decomp: The three entries below run on native ports built from the decompilations
rather than in an emulator — see src/client/env/games/n64. Each reads a
bare .z64 once to extract its assets, so the No-Intro zip has to be
unpacked — harkinianPort carries the matching unzip recipe.
